propositions: Large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) are blocked by the bugfix-size gate when they lack an acceptable plan-review attestation, even if the plan review passed and was signed by an unpinned developer environment.

The gate's not-pinned arm returns an affirmative mismatch verdict for any attestation signed by an environment not listed in trusted_environments.yaml, classifying it as a blocking finding regardless of whether the plan review was genuinely completed.

No client exists in the repository to obtain an attestation from the prod op-cert service, and the service deliberately does not persist signed envelopes, making it impossible for a developer to satisfy the gate's provenance requirement through any documented executable path.

The fix removes source-of-certification verification and gates only on the fact that an attested, subject-bound, lifecycle-valid plan review has been completed, eliminating the unsatisfiable cross-host trust root constraint for contributors.
Subject binding (ticket id and kind verification from the signed payload) is re-asserted as an explicit module step to prevent replay of valid attestations across different tickets or kinds.
